text: G59's reading 13, packet d3_pk_propose_1200 (T3-127 to T3-196, 100 lines) and the held lines, before their rows: (1) Four more candidate groups. NOTICE: the room shows its work to people outside the canvas whom it wants to see it, the creators, team or streamer the mark shows, a company it addresses, the press; it hopes for their notice, shares the coverage and celebrates acknowledgement (TeamDignitas c0036, gameattack c0049, sakuragakuin c0035, rickandmorty c0251, starlightstage c0122); the held loltyler1-003 (viewers placing to get the streamer's attention), corridor-069 (asking the crew to address the chat in a video) and Summit1G-044 (keeping the meme alive to see the streamer's reaction) join it. TsundereSharks-029 crossposts the finished shark to the canvas sub to get it noticed, P11's announcement. BOTH: members who belong to both rooms in a contest or at a border say they are torn or proud of both, and the room reassures them or still counts them (canucks c0125, kamenrider c0031, portugal c0304); iastate-028 (ruled one room's in packet 1100) moves to it. OFFEND: members argue whether a joke, taunt or word in canvas talk offends, and refuse slurs and hate symbols: they object, correct, apologise, remove the words, tell the speaker to leave, and cover swastikas (rocketleague c0728, runescape c0549, canucks c0190, anarchism c0093, kanye c0277, de c0459, EraseThePlace c0122); P02 still holds a swastika removed from the room's own mark. STRAIN: a member steps away under strain or the room repairs a quarrel between members: the work turns stressful or personal, a member is criticised or yelled at over a pixel or a proposal, others rebuke the harsh speaker, the speaker apologises, or the member leaves (cubers c0136, detroitlions c0113, futurama c0006); corridor-016 (packet 0700), funhaus-060 and ockytop-057 (packet 0800), ruled one room's each, move to it now that six rooms show the act; K02 states giving up for too few hands or room, not for strain. (2) BORN takes a sub made for a canvas figure, a canvas sub given flairs and channels, and the held opticgaming-039 (strangers copying a visible pattern into a force, c0151, c0207); FAIR takes a trick that took out a rival's work judged brilliant or dirty (utaustin c0171). (3) Held: C01 holds mock state offices, an annual order's oaths and elections (indonesia c0044, AprilKnights c0041, c0087); K04 holds the colour faith judging rivals, guests and allies, the void consuming, and ideology argued from the canvas (orderofthebluecorner c0018, PurplePixels c0197, theblackvoid c1553, anarcho_capitalism c0202, animalcrossing c0141); P19 holds hosts ruling on guests (ainbowroad c1793, thebluecorner c0804); P11 holds what the work and the timer meant, helpers rewarded and an ended attempt thanked (vinesauce c0076, AcePlace c0080, Pigifs c0038, harrypotter c0309, shield c0083); K02 holds weak turnout, doubt and an outclassed work (diablo c0052, transgender c0006, FloydVsVoid c0192); P16 holds pixels given to other works and help bartered for space (paladins c0132, yuyuyu c0018); P21 an agreement that could not reach a chat's helpers (yugioh c0112); R02 a proposal sent to the room doing the work (ufl c0019); P17 a flag alliance's channel (iceland c0057); P13 a canvas figure kept as an emoji (picturegame c0003); P07 an appeal to an attacker (loliconsunite c0063); P06 an insider griefer disowned (paladins c0217); P14 refusing hand placement because others script (egypt c0024); P02 an adopted rogue shard and a member's own word under the flag (ainbowroad c0137, Jamaica c0003). (4) Outside the scope: the subs' ordinary rule changes and debates (T3-185 except the canvas subs), a hacked sub, a raid after the sub's fiasco, offensive posts and retorts on the joke day, election talk, a member's own fan art. The remaining held lines: Cornwall-029 SPOT (reading 8), detroitlions-012 P01 (reading 10), russia-031 HIDE (reading 12). G59's reading 14, packet d3_pk_propose_1300 (T3-197 1, unplaced 61), before its rows, and the minting decision (stage section 3): (1) parahumans-015 heeds the creator's wish not to be pinged and proposes a separate sub so as not to trouble him (c0053, c0063), and metalcore-041 worries that the memorial's attention may hurt the person it honours (c0166); both join NOTICE, whose statement will name the room's turn toward the people its mark shows, seeking their notice or sparing them it. (2) The 61 unplaced lines: members who do not understand a call or ask what the effort, a name or an operation means join EXPLAIN (Dustforce c0002, FlipnoteStudio3D c0002, shield c0019, THE_R c0003, pakistan c0277, parrots c0076, GranColombia c0022), as does an account of why some pictures survive (shitredditsays c0025); the official app required for placing joins SITE (de c0697); calling the work addictive joins COST (Summit1G c0003); a sign made a link so that people come to coordinate joins RETURN (orderofthebluecorner c0005); a canvas room giving its small mark a meaning its followers share and promoting its pattern join BORN (TreePlace c0010, rainbowgrid c0027); a member bowing out over an obscene drawing and reported bans join OFFEND (dallasstars c0002); locating the work by its neighbours is P04 (samuraijack c0236). Outside the scope: the subs' April Fools play and ordinary moderation, links to other subs, remarks on other rooms' pictures and prank styles, a sales pitch, a death joke about an artist, a broadcast argument. Not shown: bare event titles and links, lost bodies, a bare reaction (albania-031, mechanicalkeyboards-057, norge-039, wow-074, cavestory-015, morrowind-068, polska-042, landry-013, satania-066). One room: arriving a day late and wishing one had known (AMD-045, corridor-042), feeling territorial (AcePlace-058), a slur against the repair talk (costa_rica-057), questioning a label (porterrobinson-019), retaliation against a coworker after the canvas (survivor-061). (3) Minting: none. The unplaced themes that name an act point at targets that third-order themes already hold: questions about what a call or the canvas means at T3-016's, the subs' April Fools play at T3-048's, T3-095's, T3-097's and T3-100's; the rest are bare mentions or single rooms. The late arrivals are two rooms' (AMD t20, corridor t12), fewer than the several the rule asks for; bangladesh-060's theme is placed under T3-036. So no theme is minted, no member is reassigned, and no line is re-lifted at this leg. Next: d3_rulings/propose-spec-1300.txt, then coverage over all fourteen packets

D3a-55 candidate rules, before any element or ruling is written (stage section 3; G59, G59a; QD3-002, induction). The coverage check passed: 1,362 propose lines in 14 packets, each with one row in 15 spec files, none twice. Fifteen groups each show a shared act that no element's statement or range and no arrow states, in rooms of their own; each enters the model as a candidate (status candidate, since D3, origin propose), with a history line (event entered, move developing working hypotheses), a move logged and a snap. Ids are new (none of P23 to P34 or K05 to K07 was ever used). Processes: P23 the chat (227 lines, 199 rooms; T4-010, D02); P24 asking and explaining what the canvas, a call and a picture mean (172, 152; T4-003, D01); P25 the work bringing people into the room (169, 135; T4-025, D07); P26 new jokes made of the work (41, 41; T4-004, D05); P27 choosing and changing the spot before any loss (20, 20; T4-014, D04); P28 a room formed for the canvas around a mark (17, 14; T4-023 and T4-002, D05 and D06); P29 arguing offence and refusing slurs and hate symbols (15, 14; T4-024, D05); P30 turning the work toward the people the mark shows (11, 11; T4-025, D07); P31 arguing whether covering others' work is fair (7, 7; T4-015, D04); P32 members stepping away under strain and quarrels repaired (6, 6; T4-012, D01); P33 hiding plans from rivals and reaching into their venues (5, 5; T4-010 and T4-020, D02 and D08); P34 members who object to the canvas posts turning on the room's own mark (2, 2; T4-002, D06). Conditions: K05 members' own time and devices (19, 19; T4-009 and T4-026, D02 and D07); K06 the site's limits and faults (14, 13; T4-009, D02); K07 members who belong to both rooms (4, 4; T4-016, D04). The tier and dimension follow where each group's lines lift. Each warrant is written into its history line: why no element holds the act (G59a), and the rooms that show it. P34 rests on two rooms and K07 on four; both are named thin in their range. The rulings: C-groups accept, kind proposal, pair a line of another room in the same group, the candidate id in the reason; H-groups reject, naming the element or arrow that holds the act; NOT reject; OUT and PART particular; P-G6 particular (NONPORTABLE, G6). No line is pending. Next: d3_rulings/propose-candidates.json, then d3_enter_candidate.py
